business_process: Workforce and agent identity and access
description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for 45,000 employees and about 52,000 contractor sales associates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division application federates to SYS-G1; no sign-in means no transaction platform, title production, loan origination, or wire release
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts for each critical system; title wire release falls back to bank-token entry by two officers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Network hub, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B; links to offices, title closing rooms, and sales centers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The Closing Communications Portal, the TMCC integration service, and the Homebuilding ERP run behind the hubs
manual_workaround: Direct provider failover paths; cellular failover at closing rooms
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Cloud platform and network operations teams
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: TMCC; Homebuilding ERP; Group Data Platform; payee verification service

business_process: Treasury and payments hub: wire and ACH release, positive pay, payee verification
description: Bank connectivity for all escrow, trust, operating, and trade partner accounts at 6 banks; about $208 million a day of title disbursements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Closings fund the same day; a missed disbursement breaches closing instructions (Fla. Stat. 626.8473(4) worked example) and lender and seller contracts
manual_workaround: Bank portals with hardware tokens and dual approval; manual callback log kept on paper
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Title disbursements; brokerage escrow refunds; property management owner payouts; trade partner payments; agent commissions

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FTC (314.4(j)), state, and Form 8-K Item 1.05 clocks keep running during an outage; fraud monitoring of mailboxes stops
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division depends on the SOC for detection and the facts behind every notice

description: Group email, files, and chat for all employees and contractor agents (SYS-G4)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agents, transaction coordinators, closers, and loan officers coordinate every closing by email; it is also the main fraud channel, so recovery must restore mail-flow controls first
manual_workaround: Closing Communications Portal messaging; phone; portal document exchange
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions; Homebuilding legacy email tenant is separate until 2027-03-31

description: Settlement, funds receipt, and outgoing disbursement wires for about 510 closings a business day from title escrow trust accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Closings and recordings are scheduled to the hour; buyers lose rate locks and possession dates; trust funds may be used only per closing instructions (626.8473(4))
manual_workaround: Disbursement by bank portal with paper callback log and two officers; closings moved to the next day with lender agreement
dependent_third_parties: Title production vendor (states RTO 12 hours); banks
dependent_people_or_facilities: Title closers and disbursement teams in 7 states
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Brokerage transactions (58% of closings); Homebuilding closings (15%); Home Loans fundings

business_process: Wire instruction delivery and closing communications
description: Delivery of closing documents and wire instructions to buyers and sellers through the Closing Communications Portal (SYS-B2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the portal, staff fall back to email, which is exactly the channel business email compromise exploits
manual_workaround: Instructions read to the buyer by phone from a verified number only; no email instructions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Title is co-data owner; wire instructions come from SYS-M2

description: Contracts, compliance review, documents, and deadlines for about 680 transaction sides a business day (SYS-B1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines (inspection, financing, closing) run daily; compliance review gates commission payment
manual_workaround: Read-only export of open files each night; paper checklists
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds Title order opening and Home Loans loan files

description: Underwriting decisions, closing disclosures, and funding wires for about 230 loans a business day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Funding is tied to scheduled closings; closing disclosure timing rules make late changes costly
manual_workaround: Manual funding authorization by two officers through SYS-G5 bank portals
dependent_third_parties: LOS vendor; investors; credit reporting agencies
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Funds Title closings for brokerage and Homebuilding buyers

description: Title searches, commitments, policies, and settlement statements (SYS-M2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commitments must be ready before closing; a 1-day outage shifts closings
manual_workaround: Underwriter title plant access; manual commitment preparation for urgent files
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Brokerage and Homebuilding closings

business_process: Loan origination, disclosures, and rate locks
description: Applications, disclosures, pricing, and rate locks for about 600 applications a business day (SYS-M1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Disclosure timing deadlines and rate lock expirations; investor commitments
manual_workaround: Paper application intake; rate lock extensions approved by secondary marketing
dependent_third_parties: LOS vendor; pricing engine vendor; AVM vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Leads from the brokerage CRM (SYS-B3) and Homebuilding sales (SYS-H2)

business_process: Earnest money escrow deposits, refunds, and reconciliation
description: Receipt, deposit, refund, and monthly reconciliation of earnest money in brokerage escrow accounts (about 41,000 transactions a year)
process_owner: Florida Broker of Record (for each state, its Broker of Record)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deposits must reach escrow by the end of the third business day (r. 61J2-14.008(3) worked example); disputes have notice deadlines (r. 61J2-10.032)
manual_workaround: Bank branch deposits; manual ledger; refunds held until callback verification
dependent_people_or_facilities: Escrow accounting team; Brokers of Record
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payee verification service (SYS-G5)

description: Borrower portal for applications, documents, and conditions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Borrowers can apply and upload by phone and email for a day
manual_workaround: Phone applications; secure upload link from the LOS vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Homebuilding buyers (78% finance with Home Loans)

description: Daily and monthly three-way reconciliation of title trust accounts at 4 banks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily reconciliation detects diverted or duplicate disbursements; monthly reconciliation is a license and underwriter duty
manual_workaround: Bank statements and ledger exports reconciled in spreadsheets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Treasury hub positive pay files

business_process: New-home sales, contracts, and buyer deposits
description: Sales contracts, buyer deposits (escrowed at a bank unless waived, Fla. Stat. 501.1375 worked example), and lender referrals (SYS-H2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 80 contracts a business day; deposits must follow the escrow terms in each contract
manual_workaround: Paper contracts; deposits taken by check only
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Leads to Home Loans (SYS-M1); orders to Title

business_process: Home completion, closing readiness, and handover
description: Final inspections, certificate of occupancy tracking, closing scheduling, and smart-home activation at handover
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 76 closings a business day depend on Title and Home Loans; handover includes transferring smart-home control to the buyer
manual_workaround: Manual closing checklist; device reset at the home
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Title closing schedule (BP-MT01); Home Loans funding (BP-MT04)

description: License checks, account creation, and removal for about 12,500 joiners and 11,000 leavers a year
process_owner: Residential Brokerage director of agent services
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Departing agents keep access to client files and email until removed
manual_workaround: Managing brokers request emergency disablement through the SOC
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 contractor identity tier

description: Listings, client records, lead routing, and buyer lead scoring (SYS-B3)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lost leads and listing updates reduce revenue but closings continue
manual_workaround: Listing service direct entry; spreadsheet lead lists
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Lead feed to Home Loans

business_process: Property management rent collection and owner distributions
description: Rent collection and monthly ACH owner distributions for about 21,000 rental homes (SYS-B4)
process_owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rents post daily; owner distributions are due monthly under management agreements
manual_workaround: Distributions delayed with owner notice; checks for urgent cases
dependent_third_parties: Property management platform vendor; payment processor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Owner payout changes go through SYS-G5 payee verification (gap 2)

description: Rental applications, consumer report screening, and lease execution for about 68,000 applications a year (SYS-B4)
process_owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Applicants wait; adverse action notices have content rules (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a))
manual_workaround: Manual screening using the consumer reporting agency portal
dependent_third_parties: Tenant screening vendor; consumer reporting agencies

description: Construction schedules, purchase orders, and variance tracking for about 19,000 homes a year (SYS-H1)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crews and deliveries are scheduled days ahead; jobsite safety plans are paper-based
manual_workaround: Printed schedules for the next 5 days; phone dispatch
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Hosted on the group cloud platform (SYS-G3)

description: Weekly ACH payments to about 9,500 trade partners (about $5.8 billion a year), and bank account changes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payments run weekly; a missed run delays crews and triggers lien risk
manual_workaround: Manual payment file approved by two officers through SYS-G5
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payee verification service (SYS-G5); gap 2

description: Loan delivery, purchase advice reconciliation, and investor reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Investor commitments allow a few days of delay at a cost
manual_workaround: Manual delivery files
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group treasury cash planning

business_process: Group Data Platform analytics and reporting
description: Analytics across divisions, including affiliate referral and capture reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Not needed for closings; holds aggregated customer information, so protection matters more than speed
manual_workaround: Reports from source systems
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Brokerage, Home Loans, Title, and Homebuilding feeds (gap 4)

description: Monthly close, consolidation, and SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; Form 8-K Item 1.05 depends on this team when an incident is material
manual_workaround: Prior-period workpapers; outside counsel support
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions report results

description: Payroll for 45,000 employees and agent commission payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; commission payments follow closings
manual_workaround: Prior payroll file re-run
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Agent commission account changes (gap 2)

description: Corporate relocation programs and referrals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Relocation files can wait several days
manual_workaround: Email and phone
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Referrals to Home Loans

business_process: Warranty service and smart-home device management
description: Warranty requests and the smart-home platform for about 38,000 homes (SYS-H2)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Homeowners keep local control of locks and thermostats; remote management can wait
manual_workaround: Phone requests; on-site device resets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

business_process: Design studio selections and card deposits
description: Option selections and card deposits through a processor hosted payment page
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Selections can be rescheduled
manual_workaround: Paper selection sheets; payment by check
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None
